title: The Good Samaritan
summaryZh: 世界充滿毀壞人的罪惡與迷惑人的假先知，唯有來到十字架前才能尋得豐盛生命與永生。
lines: "The thief cometh not but to steal, and to kill, and to destroy."
「盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞。」
"I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly."
「我來了，是要叫他們得生命，並且得的更豐盛。」
Notice the difference: there's a thief that comes to kill, to destroy; to kill you.
注意這區別：有一個盜賊來是為了殺害、毀壞；要殺害你。
But Jesus said, "I've come to give them life, and to give them life more abundantly."
但耶穌說：「我來是要賜給他們生命，並賜給他們更豐盛的生命。」
All over the world sin is rampaging, raping, ravaging humanity: violence, terrorism.
在世界各地，罪惡正在肆虐、強暴、蹂躪人類：暴力、恐怖主義。
We read it every day in our newspapers: murder, muggers and rapists in our major cities have become a major problem.
我們每天在報紙上讀到：謀殺，我們大城市的搶劫犯和強姦犯已成為一個重大問題。
Thieves have wounded and stripped this man, and departed from him, and left him half dead; alone and forsaken.
強盜打傷並剝去這人的衣服，就離開了他，把他留下半死不活；孤單且被遺棄。
When he came to and got his consciousness back, he found himself crushed and unable to move, just like you.
當他甦醒過來並恢復意識時，他發現自己被壓垮且無法動彈，就像你一樣。
You'll find yourself-- sin has destroyed you, and you cannot move.
你會發現自己——罪已經毀滅了你，而你無法動彈。
The Bible says that we're dead in sins and trespasses.
聖經說我們死在過犯和罪惡之中。
The Bible says, "She that liveth in pleasure is dead while she lives."
聖經說：「那好宴樂的寡婦，正活著的時候也是死的。」
You can be physically alive, but spiritually dead.
你可能身體活著，靈裡卻是死的。
It cannot save itself, it cannot move, it cannot get up out of the ditch.
它無法自救，無法動彈，無法從溝渠中爬起來。
That's why Christ came and died on the cross.
這就是為什麼基督降世並死在十字架上。
The man is going to die; you're going to die.
那個人快要死了；你也快要死了。
And then there came some salvation quacks along.
然後出現了一些救恩的庸醫。
The world is full of false messiahs, and false prophets, and false christs.
這個世界充滿了假彌賽亞、假先知和假基督。
Jonestown down in Guyana is still fresh in our memories where Jim Jones went and 900 people died.
位於蓋亞那的瓊斯鎮在我們記憶中依然猶新，吉姆·瓊斯去到那裡，有九百人喪生。
And how many of those false cults there are all over the world today, these false messiahs promising all kinds of things.
今天在世界各地有多少那樣的異端邪教，這些假彌賽亞應許各樣的事情。
Jesus said, "Take heed that no man deceive you."
耶穌說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。」
He warned that many false prophets shall rise and shall deceive many.
祂警告說，將有許多假先知起來，迷惑多人。
Paul said, "Evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived, as we approach the end of the age."
保羅說：「作惡的和迷惑人的，必越久越惡，欺哄人也被人欺哄，隨著我們接近這世代的終結。」
John said many antichrists would come.
約翰說會有許多敵基督到來。
He said, "Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God," because of the false prophets that have gone out into the world.
他說：「親愛的弟兄啊，一切的靈，你們不可都信，總要試驗那些靈是出於神的不是，」因為有許多假先知已經出來了。
Then as we approach the end of the age, they will intensify, they will get worse and worse, and more believable all the time.
然後隨著我們接近這世代的終結，他們會變本加厲，他們會變得越來越糟，且越來越令人信以為真。
可信的（令人信以為真的）
Many people will follow them to their doom and to their death.
許多人會跟隨他們步向滅亡和死亡。
A priest came along... think of it now, a priest came along: a preacher, a clergyman.
有一個祭司走過來……現在想一想，一個祭司走過來：一個傳道人，一個神職人員。
And it says that he looked over and he saw this man over there suffering and dying and wounded and stripped.
經上說他看過去，看到這人在那裡受苦、垂死、受傷且被剝去衣服。
And he passed by on the other side.
Now he was too busy on his way, probably to a religious conference, to stop and help this poor man.
當時他在路上太忙了，可能正要去參加一個宗教會議，以至於無法停下來幫助這個可憐的人。
Paul wrote to Timothy, "Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof."
保羅寫信給提摩太：「有敬虔的外貌，卻背了敬虔的實意。」
You see, religion will not save anybody.
你看，宗教不能拯救任何人。
Sure, you have religion, but that's not going to save you.
沒錯，你有宗教信仰，但那救不了你。
You are saved by Jesus Christ.
你是藉著耶穌基督得救的。
By the blood that was shed on the cross, by His resurrection, by what is called in the Bible the kerygma: the story of Christ on the cross.
藉著在十字架上所流的血，藉著祂的復活，藉著聖經中所稱的「初傳」：基督在十字架上的故事。
When God took your sins and laid them on Christ, and He became sin for us who knew no sin.
當神將你的罪孽擔當並歸在基督身上，祂便使那無罪的，替我們成為罪。
That's the only way anybody's going to be saved.
這是任何人得救的唯一途徑。
I don't care who you are.
No one is going to go to the Kingdom of Heaven except the way God said go.
除了神所說的道路，沒有人能進神的國度。
You might not like it that way, but that's the way it is.
你可能不喜歡那樣，但事實就是如此。
"There is a way that seemeth right unto man, but the end thereof are the ways of death," says the Bible.
聖經說：「有一條路，人以為正，至終成為死亡之路。」
Then you have the ability and then you have the vision to go out and help your neighbor.
然後你才有能力，也才有異象去幫助你的鄰舍。
